name: test-generator
description: Generates unit tests for a given source file. Detects the test framework from context and produces tests matching project style.

inputs.name: Source Code
inputs.description: The source code to generate tests for

inputs.name: Source File Path
inputs.description: Path to the source file (for import resolution)

inputs.name: Context
inputs.description: Additional project context (existing tests, test config, etc.)

inputs.name: Test Framework
inputs.description: Test framework to use (vitest, jest, mocha, pytest, xunit). Auto-detected if not set.
